title: Chicken Jalfrezi - diet

Method:-
Pre-heat oven to Gas Mark 6
Roast chicken for 40 minutes, allow to cool and strip meat from bone
Chop 1 chilli
Cut and de-seed the other chillies, leaving them whole
Heat some oil in a wok and add the garlic, chopped chillies, chopped tomatoes, cumin, garam masala, turmeric, sugar and salt
Stir-fry for 4 or 5 minutes, do not let it burn
Add the cooled chicken and the whole chillies
Stir-fry for another 3 minutes
Add 200ml water and the yoghurt
Stir together and simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce has reduced by a third
In a separate pan:
Add oil and fry the quartered onions and pepper for 4 minutes
Add the quartered tomatoes and fry for another 3 minutes
To thicken the chicken:
Mix water and cornflour and Stir into the chcken mixture
Cook until thickened
Mix
Remove the whole chillies
Mix together
Serve
